messages:
alia: Noticing sustained spike in audit-events ingest for the last 3 hours. Queues growing, ES indexing lag, costs jumping. Any quick mitigations?

sam: Yea saw that. Which pipeline? main-audit or shipper-v2?

alia: Mostly main-audit. tail shows lots of customer:write and role:update events from a couple tenants.

morgan: Putting this on the oncall radar. @sre-oncall can you throttle shipper-v2? If we drop to best-effort we keep latency SLOs for hosteds.

sre-oncall: I can flip a throttle rule on the ingress LB for non-critical tenants. Want sampling first?

pavan: Before throttling, two asks: 1) preserve customer-facing audit delivery guarantees for compliance tenants; 2) avoid decrypt-roundtrip on hot path for events — KMS latency is burning CPU.

june: For point 2, we could move to envelope encryption where shippers attach ciphertext and we do async rewrap. That reduces KMS calls in hot path.

security-bot: CI alert: dependency lxml has a moderate CVE flagged in our shipper image (CVE-2024-XXXX). Not related to ingest but flagged during vuln scan.

morgan: Good catch. We should triage offline, but not block immediate mitigations.

sam: Short-term plan proposal: 1) enable tenant-prioritized queueing + circuit-breaker for low-tier tenants, 2) sample write events for non-compliance tenants at 1/10, 3) offload KMS decrypts to async worker pool, 4) extend index refresh interval for ES by 30s temporarily. Thoughts?

alia: +1. For customer-facing validation we must ensure sampled events still preserve required fields & signatures. Can't break audit proofs.

pavan: About signatures: we recently added event_signature in schema v2. If we sample, we still need to keep signature, timestamp, and tenant_id. Also need to surface in dropped-event notifications to affected customers.

june: Schema change note: event_signature currently optional. We should make it required for compliance-tenants. That's a tiny schema migration but needs rollout steps.

morgan: Can we do a rolling change: enforce required at ingestion for flagged tenants only? That avoids mass re-ingest.

sam: Implementation detail: circuit-breaker should be token-bucket per-tenant with debt state persisted. If tenant exceeds debt, mark events for sampled path and emit metric 'audit.sampler.tripped'. Also send webhook to their admin if compliance-tier=false.

sre-oncall: I'll implement a temporary RBAC gating rule to ensure shipper service accounts can't bypass sampler when tripped. Need the exact role name.

alia: RBAC change: add role 'audit.shipper.sampler' and ensure only shipper instances get it. Ops will deploy IAM change in staging first.

devops: FYI, making RBAC changes requires a canary and 2-hour maintenance window for private deployments. Documented in runbook.

security-bot: Note for vuln triage: ensure CVE patch is included in the shipper image rebuild — link: https://ci.internal/rebuilds/4321

pavan: Cost estimate: sampling + async KMS should cut token-costs ~25-35% for this spike window. ES refresh change will reduce indexing IO by ~15%.

june: We need to update customer-facing docs for audit guarantees: add a section on sampling behavior and timeline for sampled-event retrieval on the dashboard. Legal will need to sign off.

morgan: Action items: 1) @sre-oncall enable per-tenant circuit-breaker & RBAC gate (P0, 30m), 2) @devops schedule shipper image rebuild with CVE patch (P1, 3h), 3) @pavan + @june implement async KMS worker and schema enforcement for compliance tenants (P1, 6h), 4) @alia write notification copy for sampled/drop alerts (P1, 2h).

alia: I'll draft notification and sync with legal. Also adding metrics to track "audit.drop.count" and "audit.reencrypt.latency".

sam: If we can get those mitigations live, we should reduce backpressure. Also let's add a postmortem checklist item: consider persistent per-tenant rate-limits and quota pricing to discourage noisy tenants.

morgan: Agreed. I'll open follow-up PRs for rate-limits + pricing flag.

alia: Thanks everyone. Will update thread with progress.

sre-oncall: Circuit-breaker enabled for low-tier tenants, sampler metrics firing. ES refresh interval bumped. Monitoring dashboards updated.

devops: Ship image rebuild started, CVE fixed in base image, pushing canary.

pavan: Async KMS workers deployed to staging, saw 60% fewer KMS calls on hot path in test harness.

alia: Noted. closing loop once costs stabilize.

morgan: Great work. Marking incident as mitigated for now.

security-bot: Incident log entry created: INC-2026-042: audit-ingest-backpressure-mitigation.
